info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Pyrargy Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Pyrargy Produce Detail Management API facilitates the addition of detailed information about Pyrargy produce items to the catalog. This endpoint allows producers and catalog managers to upload and register new produce details, enhancing the visibility and traceability of products. Typical users include agricultural producers, catalog managers, and supply chain specialists looking to improve inventory management and product information accuracy. By providing structured data, this API supports better decision-making and customer engagement.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit detailed information about pyrargy produce. Ensure that all required fields are filled out correctly to successfully create a new entry.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Pyrargy produce operation. The data must conform to the specified schema, allowing the system to process the information accurately.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the details are returned.

pyrargy_produce_id.description: The unique identifier for the pyrargy produce.

quantity.description: The quantity of pyrargy produce requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority order.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the pyrargy produce.

CreateCatalogPyrargyProduceDetailRequest.description: Schema to represent the details of a request for pyrargy produce operations.
